items.title: Generic v-adic equidistribution for semiabelian varieties with monocritical arithmetically T-effective toric metrics
items.author: Wei Xue
items.difficulty_reason: The main equidistribution theorem combines all-place analytic local trivialization and adelic metric construction with arithmetic height/volume inequalities, canonical and quasi-canonical compression paths, monocritical toric measure control and a variational equidistribution argument. Full original big/T-effective, semipositivity, monocriticality, arithmetic-T-effectivity and generic-small-sequence assumptions retained with all source-local proof constructions. This is an independent global arithmetic theorem beyond the old local trivialization support.

primary.label: complete original generic equidistribution theorem with monocritical/arithmetic T-effectivity assumptions and quasi-canonical limiting measure

proof_spans.label: full author conventions, local trivializations, metric/height construction, canonical/quasi-canonical compression, monocritical proof and supporting appendices; separate conditional Bogomolov context uncounted

contexts.label: complete original semiabelian, toric compactification, metric and canonical abelian-line-bundle setup
